properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated origins the API answers CORS preflight for.

properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing key for access tokens. Never commit a real one.

properties.name: app.bootstrap.admin-email
properties.description: Email of the first admin, created at boot when set. Empty means skip.

properties.name: app.bootstrap.admin-name
properties.description: Display name of the first admin.

properties.name: app.bootstrap.demo-password
properties.description: When set, seeds the demo tenant and its users with this password. Empty means skip.
